title: fix(cron): reject blank command replacements when editing jobs
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Editing a command automation with `--command "$EMPTY"` or whitespace-only text reports success while leaving the previous command scheduled. A simultaneous name edit succeeds, making the silent command no-op harder to notice.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reject explicitly blank commands at the existing CLI edit-validation boundary, alongside blank script validation, before any Gateway access. Omitted commands remain valid and nonblank shell text retains its original bytes. The original fix and credit by @zhangguiping-xydt are preserved.

## User Impact

An accidental empty shell variable now exits nonzero with `--command must not be blank`, without applying other edits. No new option, clearing semantics, scheduler policy, schema, or permissions.

## Evidence

Built current main `060a63ff446a05ec469d4d9197af74536681f884` and candidate in secretless Linux containers with Node 26.12.0. Used the shipped `node openclaw.mjs --profile … automations add/edit/show` against isolated Gateways. Created disabled command automations storing `printf old`; no model or scheduled command ran.

Captured results for an empty value and, separately, whitespace-only text:

```text
main: edit --command '' --name Renamed --json
exit=0; readback name=Renamed; argv=["sh","-lc","printf old"]
main: edit --command ' <tab> ' --name Renamed --json
exit=0; readback name=Renamed; argv=["sh","-lc","printf old"]

candidate: both edits exit=1
{"ok":false,"error":{"type":"cli_error","message":"--command must not be blank"}}
readback: original name and argv unchanged

both revisions: metadata-only edit succeeds; command is preserved
both revisions: nonblank replacement succeeds; quoted and trailing whitespace preserved
PROOF PASSED base
PROOF PASSED cand
```

The first baseline harness attempt waited for an obsolete readiness string; correcting it to the Gateway's emitted ready event produced the results above. This was a harness failure, not a product failure.

Focused candidate checks: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/cron-cli/register.cron-edit.test.ts` — 61 passed; changed-file Oxfmt and Oxlint — no errors or warnings. One regression in the existing table covers blank-command rejection before any RPC, including a simultaneous metadata edit. Whitespace handling and both successful controls were also exercised through the built CLI.

Simplified the original two added table rows to one regression at the same boundary. Whole-PR delta against the merge base: production +3/-0, tests +1/-0. The three production lines reuse existing normalization and error handling; no new abstraction or state.

Merge danger: two-way door; reverting restores the previous CLI behavior without migration. Blast radius: automation/cron CLI users explicitly supplying a blank command replacement; other edits and nonblank commands are unchanged.
